company.shortDescription: Swvl offers an app that allows customers to book fixed rate rides on buses and vans in their network.
company.description: Swvl offers an app that allows customers to book fixed-rate rides on buses and vans in their network. It allows people to share a ride in a van or bus during morning and evening commutes for a fixed flat fare with no surge pricing. Through an app, one can book a ride at an affordable rate. Launched in 2017, Swvl has its headquarters in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
